location: Viña del Mar, Chile · Remote worldwide
summary: I'm a cloud architect and software engineer with 13+ years of experience building products and running them in production. I founded Eleva and lead architecture and development for Liquor Cart at Electronic Payments. My work combines C#/.NET and Angular development with AWS architecture, production operations and technical leadership.
highlights: Founded **Eleva in 2017** to help schools run consistent staff evaluations. Built and still operate the SaaS platform, which won **Startup Chile Ignite in 2022**.

Led the replacement of a legacy commerce platform with **Liquor Cart**, connecting an AWS storefront with stores' existing registers. The business can now run online and in-store commerce through one connected system.
Built Eleva's deployment pipelines to make releases repeatable. The platform completed **19 production deployments in a 30-day period without failures**, with changes live in **about nine minutes**.

experience.title: Lead Software Architect and Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: The replacement platform had to work with stores' existing on-premise registers. Designed its integration with Magento on AWS and wrote **approximately 90% of the C# middleware**, allowing paid online orders to flow into those registers.

Built a recovery workflow for orders and payments that fall out of sync. It can complete or cancel orders, void or refund payments, and escalate unresolved cases to an operator. Idempotent processing allows retries without repeating payment actions.

Kept store integrations separate through dedicated RabbitMQ virtual hosts and automated their setup and removal. Added message retries and an error queue that operators can replay, giving failed integrations a defined recovery path.

Replaced manual deployments with infrastructure defined in CDK and automated pipelines across dev, QA and production AWS accounts. The team now follows a consistent release process, with approval required before changes reach production.

Established development conventions and mentored junior engineers to give a **six-person team** a consistent way to deliver changes. The project reached 178 merged pull requests, with **1,600+ unit tests on every push**.

experience.title: Founder and Platform Architect
bullets: Built Eleva so schools could evaluate staff using consistent, auditable rules and plan improvements. Versioned rubrics preserve the criteria behind each result, and weighted 360-degree scoring adjusts for missing evaluators while each school's data stays separate.

Defined dev, QA and production in a shared CDK stack with environment-specific configuration. New environments can be added through a pull request, and automated releases include ECS rollback when a deployment fails.

Built an operations panel so infrastructure reviews could use the system's deployed state. Reviewers can see architecture and configuration drift from CloudFormation, then trace each release to its source code through commit-tagged images.

Designed the .NET application to tolerate scheduled shutdowns, then configured ECS and RDS to stop on weekday evenings and restart on request. This avoids leaving compute resources running through idle periods.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
bullets: Worked on the C#/.NET Core backend of a self-service kiosk platform, from requirements through production troubleshooting. Built the Angular 13 frontend for the Clover SMB product.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Helped clients launch MVPs by building their applications and AWS infrastructure, using Angular, React, Node.js, .NET Core and Java.

experience.title: PHP Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Worked on SQL databases and PHP/ORM code for research tools at CCTVal, a scientific computing center.
